name: Olivier Dreyer
headline: Senior Strategy, Operations & Transformation Leader
positioning: Senior Strategy, Operations & Transformation leader with 15+ years across FinTech & Payments, SaaS and HealthTech. Combines strategic vision with operational depth and disciplined execution to translate ambition into scalable delivery and measurable commercial outcomes. Experience spans enterprise strategy, global operations, operating-model transformation, commercialisation, post-M&A value creation, P&L ownership and practical AI-enabled transformation.
location: UK-based; open to London, UK-remote, Europe and UAE opportunities
work_authorisation: British and French citizen with UK and EU work authorisation
highlights: $40M operating P&L with global operational leadership
Post-acquisition initiative reached a three-year $3.5M ARR target in approximately ten months and later scaled to a ~$16M annual sales run rate
Built an approximately $11M ARR pipeline for a cross-border money-movement proposition
96% client satisfaction; critical-incident resolution reduced from 2.14 to 0.22 days

experience.title: Strategy, Operations & Transformation Projects
bullets: Developing and applying strategy, operating-model, decision-governance and AI-enabled workflow approaches across live internal and professional projects.

Current work includes governed decision systems, evidence structures, deterministic business logic, human approval and operational workflow design, with AI used as a supporting capability rather than decision authority.

experience.title: Vice President, Client Services (Strategy, Innovation & Growth)
bullets: Senior leadership role reporting to the COO, with direct CEO partnership on strategy, innovation and growth across Client Services, Support, Customer Success, Education, Managed Application Services and Change Management.
Created seven monetisable services; redesigned Support pricing from a $0.47M baseline toward a $2.61M three-year target, with services projected to grow from 4.7% to 26% of revenue mix.
Established a Philippines Operations Centre of Excellence, replacing approximately £143k annual outsourcing with three hires at roughly half the cost; model was adopted by other functions.
Delivered more than $250k in Transition Service Agreement revenue and strengthened go-live, governance and customer-transition disciplines.

experience.title: Strategy & Innovation Advisory
bullets: Advised investment-management, hedge-fund and advisory organisations, including clients with more than $1B AUM, on growth, operating models and market developments.
Focused on Payments, Capital Markets and Banking trends, commercial strategy and practical execution frameworks.

experience.title: Director of Strategy
bullets: Led post-acquisition value-creation work following the Worldpay transaction; a three-year $3.5M ARR target was reached in approximately ten months and the initiative later scaled to a ~$16M annual sales run rate.
Developed a real-time cross-border money-movement proposition with an approximately $11M ARR pipeline, spanning proposition design, GTM, pricing and delivery planning.
Supported corporate strategy, geographic expansion, portfolio evaluation, board materials and SaaS/cloud modernisation across a global financial-technology environment.

experience.title: Vice President of Operations
bullets: Owned a $40M operating P&L across Client Services & Support, Customer Success, SaaS Operations, Managed Services and Education Services, leading a global team of 30+ and approximately 600 customers.
Built five delivery centres and increased workforce by approximately 350% while introducing KPI-led operating management and 24/7 support coverage.
Achieved 96% client satisfaction, 40% same-day resolution and reduced critical-incident resolution time from 2.14 to 0.22 days.

experience.title: Progressive Operations Leadership Roles
bullets: Progressed through Team Leader, Manager and Global Director roles before promotion to Vice President, with five promotions in six years.
Built and scaled international customer and operational functions from an initial team of approximately eight into a multi-country operating model.
